newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall, low retail demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall, low retail demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Friday on low consumer and low retail demand, dealers said.
"Millers turned active sellers as outstation demand fell at higher levels," one broker said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by five rupees to 1,280/1,300 rupees while M-30 fell by 10 rupees to 1,300/1,350 rupees. Sugar mill delivery also eased by 10 to 1,220/1,230 rupees.
Overall market sentiments was subdued at the close of the session. The market is closed on Monday for a Hindu festival.
